The test image shows a field-level view of soybean rows with scattered yellowing/lighter patches throughout the canopy. The SCN reference images show very similar field patterns — scattered interveinal chlorosis and yellowing throughout the canopy at the field scale, with the top-right panel of the SCN collage closely matching the test image's appearance (mixed green/yellow leaves throughout the canopy).

The pattern of diffuse, scattered yellowing visible across the whole field (not confined to lesions, spots, or stem symptoms) is characteristic of Soybean Cyst Nematode, which causes stunting and chlorosis as a root-feeding pathogen.
